question: Train A running at a speed of 99 km/hr takes 46 seconds to completely cross train B running at 72 km/hr in the opposite direction. The length of train B is 1.5 times the length of train A. Train B crosses a bridge completely in 82 seconds. The length of the bridge (in m) is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Train A (SA) = 99 km/hr

Speed of Train B (SB) = 72 km/hr

Time to cross each other = 46 seconds (opposite direction)

Length of Train B = 1.5 × Length of Train A

Time for Train B to cross bridge = 82 seconds

**Formula used:**

1 km/hr = 5/18 m/s

Relative Speed (opposite direction) = SA + SB

Distance = Speed × Time
